sn7.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || Assosi kho bilaṅgika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo || Bhāradvājagotto kira brāhmaṇo samaṇassa Gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ti || || Kupito anattamano yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekam antaṃ aṭṭhāsi || || Atha kho Bhagavā bilaṅgikassa bhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya bilaṅgikaṃ bhāradvāja-brāhmaṇaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.4:2.1: Yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati || suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa || tam eva bālam pacceti pāpaṃ || sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃ va khitto ti
